title: The banking system.
subtitle: Money becomes funding, credit and payments. Controls and infrastructure make the system work.

activities.label: Customers & distribution
activities.purpose: Help customers discover, access and use propositions across digital and assisted channels.
activities.pressure: Funding, credit losses and control obligations constrain value creation; magnitude and enterprise readiness require evidence.

activities.label: Deposits & funding
activities.purpose: Safeguard balances and connect customer relationships to the funding model; the mix and economics need evidence.
activities.pressure: Funding, credit losses and control obligations constrain value creation; magnitude and enterprise readiness require evidence.

activities.label: Lending & credit
activities.purpose: Assess risk and provide credit; product profitability and current decisions are not inferred from the activity map.
activities.pressure: Funding, credit losses and control obligations constrain value creation; magnitude and enterprise readiness require evidence.

activities.label: Payments & settlement
activities.purpose: Move money reliably across customer journeys; transaction-system ownership remains to be mapped.
activities.pressure: Funding, credit losses and control obligations constrain value creation; magnitude and enterprise readiness require evidence.

activities.label: Risk, fraud & compliance
activities.purpose: Protect customers and the bank through risk decisions, fraud controls and governance.
activities.pressure: Funding, credit losses and control obligations constrain value creation; magnitude and enterprise readiness require evidence.

activities.label: Service & resilience
activities.purpose: Keep important services available and meet applicable obligations; entity readiness is not established by an industry deadline.
activities.pressure: Funding, credit losses and control obligations constrain value creation; magnitude and enterprise readiness require evidence.

activities.label: Core platforms
activities.purpose: Enable the banking activities through core systems and modernisation. Exact application populations and dependencies remain unresolved.
activities.pressure: Funding, credit losses and control obligations constrain value creation; magnitude and enterprise readiness require evidence.

activities.label: Data, cloud & AI
activities.purpose: Support decisions, controls and customer journeys. Platform presence does not prove adoption, causal benefit or an unmet requirement.
activities.pressure: Funding, credit losses and control obligations constrain value creation; magnitude and enterprise readiness require evidence.

activities.label: People & operating change
activities.purpose: Translate strategy into operational change; ownership, allocation and net outcomes need validation.
activities.pressure: Funding, credit losses and control obligations constrain value creation; magnitude and enterprise readiness require evidence.
